name: SupaBase
description: Supabase is a Postgres-based backend platform and an open-source alternative to Firebase. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys Supabase as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Open source Firebase alternative with Postgres. Self-host Supabase via Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – no manual setup needed.
